Basic/Required 
 • 5+ years hands-on experience with implementation and support of Informatica 9.5 or higher
 • Experience building both traditional ETL scenarios in Informatica as well as non-traditional Integration scenarios
 • Demonstrated ability to architect complex integration scenarios using Informatica
 • Legally authorized to work in the United States 
 Preferred 

 • Hand-on experience with one or more of the following; Implementing Informatica Data Quality,Informatica B2B Data Exchange, Web Services, Informatica Real-time, Teradata
 • Experience with building data warehouses and working with an Enterprise Data Warehouse
 • 1+ years working in a UNIX environment
 • Oil and Gas Industry Experience with another Major
 • Demonstrated ability and willingness to provide 24x7 application support
 • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills to quickly recognize, isolate, and resolve technical problems

 Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or Computer Sciences or 5 years related IT experience

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months
